settings.howAccessWorksBody: Everyone on your team signs in with their own email and password — nobody shares a login. All of you work inside the same workspace and see the same leads, properties, and deals, tied to one workspace ID. What each person can do depends on their role, not which computer or account they're on.
settings.roleDescOwner: Full control: create, edit, delete records, manage the team, and change organization settings.
settings.roleDescAdmin: Full control: create, edit, delete records, manage the team, and change organization settings.
settings.roleDescAgent: Can create and edit leads, properties, contacts, deals, and messages — cannot delete records or manage the team.
settings.roleDescStaff: View-only: can see all workspace data but cannot create, edit, delete, or send messages.
